title: Last Round band personnel
summary: Names the trumpeters, drummer and others in the Last Round band and a one-eyed Babe Phillips.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And what instrument were you playing then?

I was playing sax. You were playing sax? I had Albert Walter who was on trumpet. Joe Paris. Either Alton Cornel. Alton Cornel was a voicemail. And he left and we got Joe Paris. And we had Albert Giles on the drums. And Katsun, he was a band with him. One-eyed babes.
Joe Phillips or whatever. Yeah, Babe Phillips.
I played some jobs with him, but he's a comical man. Yeah, he couldn't speak English out of him. No, you couldn't understand him. That's right.
